title: Indian researcher Devesh Nandal named to Harvard-led UAP Science Advisory Council
description: Indian astrophysicist Dr. Devesh Nandal has been appointed to Harvard's UAP Science Advisory Council, tasked with analyzing unexplained aerial phenomena.

title: UAP, DPDT sign MoU to boost research, innovation and IP protection
description: University of Asia Pacific and the Department of Patents, Industrial Designs and Trademarks under the Ministry of Industries signed a memorandum of understanding on Tuesday, 7 July 2026, to strengthen intellectual property protection, promote innovation and support patent registration for researchers. The signing took place at the Vice-Chancellor's Conference Room of University of Asia Pacific, followed by a programme and training session. The meeting also discussed the establishment of a Technology and Innovation Support Centre at University of Asia Pacific to enhance innovation support
